With the rapid rise of OpenClaw, integrating it into enterprise workflows to boost productivity has become an urgent need for many companies. On March 13, Tencent Cloud's Intelligent Agent Development Platform upgraded its "Enterprise-Grade OpenClaw" solution (ADP Claw). By launching five major security firewalls, a rich array of specialized plugins, and industry best-practice workflows, it ensures both security and usability, helping enterprises seamlessly incorporate OpenClaw into their business environments to enhance productivity.  

Building five "firewalls" to equip the "lobster" with an end-to-end "safe"  

As a dedicated OpenClaw solution for enterprises, security is the core advantage of Tencent Cloud's ADP Claw. ADP Claw has established five security "firewalls" covering the entire chain, providing comprehensive "safeguards" for enterprise-grade AI agents.  

First is model invocation and execution security. Through a unified security gateway, strict control is enforced based on Agent identity to prevent unauthorized access; full logging of model invocation supports security audits and issue tracing; real-time monitoring and interception of abnormal invocation behaviors, along with rate-limiting mechanisms, ensure platform stability and defend against malicious attacks and resource abuse.  

Second is dialogue input and output security. On the input side, real-time detection and interception of direct Prompt injection attacks; prevention of indirect Prompt injection attacks triggered by Agents browsing web pages or reading files; identification and filtering of sensitive information in user inputs.

items.title: 卓驭端到端 4.0 落地红旗，数据驱动「泛化」战打响
items.raw_excerpt: 3 月13 日，智驾方案商卓驭在深圳举办了“高悟性端到端 4.0”体验日。在这座以路况复杂著称的城市，卓驭试图通过对老城区窄路、人车混行街区的实测，验证其最新版本 OTA 在真实环境中的处理能力。 在深圳南头古城片区，极窄的城中村道路与盲区频现的十字路口，构成了智驾系统的考场。实测显示，卓驭端到端 4.0 在处理这些无法穷尽规则的场景时，表现出了明显的拟人化特征。 最典型的例子是系统对博弈的理解。在双向单车道的狭窄缝隙中，车辆能与对向来车进行空间博弈，灵巧绕开临停车辆。此外，其“端到端驱动三点式掉头”，让车辆在断头路等极端环境下，能像老司机一样自主规划路径并完成多次揉库，全程无需接管。 这种进化的核心逻辑在于彻底抛弃规则代码。 “业界许多方案中还有不少是规则代码在起作用。而端到端 4.0 是真正让数据说话。”卓驭科技产品总监蒋卓键表示。所谓“100% 端味”，意味着从感知到决策再到控制的完整链条中，以往依赖的大量人工预设规则已被拿掉，取而代之的是由海量数据训练出的 AI 大模型。 传统基于规则的系统如同一个拿着指令手册的操作员，遇到手册外的情况便会不知所措，而端到端模型则更像是一个通过大量实战学习经验的驾驶者，在面对未知场景时能做出更合理的自主决策。 端到端模型的成熟并非一蹴而就，其底层逻辑是卓驭构建的“双闭环”研发范式：数据闭环通过对真实行车数据的回收、清洗与标注，不断喂养模型；体验闭环则是验证过的模型上车后，利用量产车源源不断回传的长尾问题和场景数据，反哺模型优化。 这种纯粹的数据驱动路径，解决了智驾体验从“可用”到“好用”的关键障碍——确定性。更深层的意义在于，这种进化是在不改变硬件平台的前提下实现的。 随着高悟性端到端 4.0 的发布，卓驭也明确了该技术将率先落地红旗“司南智驾”，并于今年上半年通过 OTA 陆续推送给红旗 HS6 PHEV、天工 05 等多款车型。

On March 13, autonomous driving solution provider Zhuoyu held an "Advanced End-to-End 4.0" experience day in Shenzhen. In this city known for its complex road conditions, Zhuoyu aimed to validate the real-world performance of its latest OTA version through tests in narrow roads of old urban areas and mixed-traffic streets. A prime example is the system's understanding of negotiation. In narrow two-way single-lane gaps, the vehicle could engage in spatial negotiation with oncoming traffic, skillfully maneuvering around temporarily parked vehicles. Additionally, its "end-to-end-driven three-point turn" enabled the vehicle to autonomously plan paths and execute multiple parking adjustments in extreme environments like dead-end roads, mimicking an experienced driver without requiring any intervention.

"Many industry solutions still rely heavily on rule-based code, but End-to-End 4.0 truly lets data speak," said Jiang Zhuojian, Product Director at Zhuoyu Technology.
